When everyone panics, some people see a bargain instead.

Kevin Trudeau takes you back to 1929, when the stock market crashed and many people went bankrupt because they had borrowed to invest. He says the smart people did the opposite of the crowd. They saw a bargain and bought.

He ties it to the idea of seeing opportunity in adversity, as a winner did when COVID shut everything down.

The crowd acts out of fear. The winners look at the same moment and see a chance.

When did you last do the opposite of what everyone around you was doing?
